title: Finite direct image reflects module constructibility on curves
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, Lambda any commutative ring, g:Y -> Spec k a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], f:X -> Y finite, and F an etale sheaf of Lambda-modules on X. If f_*F is module-constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], then F is module-constructible. No torsion or Noetherian coefficient-ring hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 095K (finite stratification), 0959 (finite exchange), 04DZ (topological invariance), and 0A5D; direct-factor refinement for arbitrary module coefficients

proof.text: Reduce Y using universal-homeomorphism invariance. Choose disjoint affine dense opens of the one-dimensional irreducible components of the reduced Noetherian curve Y, with finite closed complement. Shrink each open so f_*F is finite locally constant: a constructible stratification contains a dense open stratum of each component. Over Spec A the finite source is Spec B. Apply lem-weil-pbc-generic-finite-algebra-splitting to the Noetherian domain A and finite algebra B. It supplies a further principal shrinking and a surjective finite etale base change U over which the reduced source is a finite disjoint union of schemes universally homeomorphic to U.

Finite exchange identifies the direct image on U with the pullback of f_*F. Pullback of a finite locally constant sheaf remains finite locally constant, by pulling back its trivializing etale cover and identifying geometric stalks. Reduction of the source and each universal-homeomorphism component preserve etale sheaves. A finite disjoint union has direct image the product of its component direct images; thus each component corresponds to a direct summand of the finite locally constant module sheaf on U.

Locally trivialize the ambient finitely generated constant module M. Its sheaf projector is locally induced by a constant idempotent endomorphism because images of finitely many generators are simultaneously locally constant. Its image is generated by the images of those generators. The summand sheaf is therefore finite locally constant for arbitrary Lambda, without any general assertion about arbitrary quotients or submodules. Topological invariance transports local constancy to each source component. The etale cover induced by U descends local constancy to the source over the dense open by composing the trivializing covers. Finite-stalk product comparison makes every source stalk a direct factor of a finitely generated direct-image stalk, so these locally constant source sheaves are finite.

Each remaining closed fibre is a finite union of artinian local schemes with residue field k. Reduction gives algebraically closed points, whose etale sheaves are constant. Finite stalk comparison gives each source module stalk as a direct summand of the finitely generated direct-image stalk. Hence these source restrictions are finite constant. The finitely many locally closed constructible source pieces form a stratification witnessing constructibility of F. Empty fibres give no source pieces.
